_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Uri kucheza Klondike Solitaire. Chinangwa chenyu ndechekutenga kero zote kuenda kwenye matumba ekuumba.

Mitemo yeMuchezeo:
- Matumba ekuumba (F1-F4): Vaka mberi kubva Ace kuenda King mumweya
- Matumba etafura (T1-T7): Vaka pasi mweya wechena (chena pamsoro pechena, chena pamsoro pechena)
- Stoko: Koka kero kuenda kwenye tumbo recheka
- Tumbo recheka (W): Kero yejuu inovapa kucheza

Makomando:
- 'draw' - Koka kero kubva stoko kuenda kwenye tumbo recheka
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Tenga kero kati kematumba
  Mifano: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count inaweza kuva 'all', inozama kutenga kero zote zvakabatana.
- 'forfeit' - Pera muchezeo mararamombe na kuzinga alama yenyu yepamhamha
- Mazita ematumba: W (tumbo recheka), F1-F4 (matumba ekuumba), T1-T7 (matumba etafura)

Munaweza kutevedza zviitiko zvakawanda mumweya mukati kwa kuzipatana nekoma:
  Mfano: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Mambo ekutonga anoweza kuwekwa pamatumba etafura asina kero.
Zviitiko zvinotevedza mukati wa mpangilio - kana chimwe chikashaya, zviitiko zvimwe zvinoripwa.
Shandisa 'forfeit' kana muchiitira muchezeo hauchinje kupinda.

format_error.no_brackets: Chimiro chechiito chisina kukodzera. Chiito chinofanira kuva pakati pemabhenji.
format_error.no_closing_bracket: Maitiro asina kukodzera. Kushaiwa kwekupedzisa bracket ']'
format_error.move_needs_args: Komando ye 'move' inohitaji chikwata na chinozokwata. Maitiro: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.count_invalid: Idadi isiyo sahihi. Tumia nambari au 'all'

move_result.drew: Akadhirowa kadhi ((s) kubva kuzvitoro kuenda kurara.
move_result.cannot_draw: Havagoni kudhonza. Zvose zviri zviviri zvinhu zvomugove nezvokurasikirwa hazvina chinhu.
move_result.invalid_pile: Zita risina kukodzera. Shandisa W, F1-F4, kana T1-T7
move_result.foundation_one_card: Inogona kutamisa kadhi rimwe chete kufanogadzira.
move_result.waste_to_foundation_ok: Kadhi rakatamiswa kubva mumarara kuenda kufanotangira F{dst}
move_result.waste_to_foundation_bad: Haikwanise kutamisa kadhi rezvinhu zvisina basa kune iyo nheyo yemapuranga
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_ok: Kardhu yakawuma kubva tableau T{src} ku foundation F{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_bad: Haikwanise kutamisa tafura kadhi kune iyo nheyo yemapuranga
move_result.foundation_to_foundation: Haikwanisi kufamba kubva pachikumbaridzo kuenda pane chimwe chikumbaradzo.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_one_card: Inogona kungofambisa kadhi rimwe chete kubva pane zvakaraswa kuenda kutafura.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_ok: Kutamiswa kadhi kubva tsvina kuti tafura T{dst}
move_result.waste_to_tableau_bad: Haikwanise kuisa kadhi rekurasikirwa pane iyo tafura murwi
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_ok: Kardhu {count} zikawuma kubva tableau T{src} ku T{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_bad: Haitungamiri kubvisa {count} kardhu(s) kubva T{src} ku T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_one_card: Inogona kungofambisa kadhi rimwe chete kubva pahwaro kuenda patafura.
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_ok: Kardhu yakawuma kubva foundation F{src} ku tableau T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_bad: Haikwanise kuisa hwaro kadhi patafura T{dst}
move_result.to_waste_or_stock: Haikwanisi kutamiswa kunzvimbo dzinoshandiswa kana kuti dzinogadzirwa zvinhu.

outcome.forfeit: Mutambo wakarasikirwa. Chiitiko chekupedzisira: {score} makadhi mune nheyo.
outcome.turn_limit: Mchezo umemalizika! Umeifikia kiwango cha juu cha {max_turns} mizunguko. Alama: {score} kadi katika msingi.
